name: beginner-strength-training
description:
Builds a 3-day-per-week beginner strength training program with compound movements, progressive overload rules, set and rep schemes, rest intervals, and a deload protocol. Gathers the user's available equipment, schedule, and goals, then produces a structured training program table.
Use when the user asks about starting a weight training program, beginner lifting, first gym routine, or how to build strength as a beginner.
Do NOT use for intermediate or advanced programming (use intermediate-strength-training or training-program-periodization), injury rehabilitation, or sport-specific conditioning (use sports-specific-conditioning).
